blocks.title: Algorithm
blocks.text: Algorithms masail hal karne ke qadam ba qadam tareeqe hain, jaise recipe khana pakane ke qadam batati hai.

Algorithms computer science ki reerh ki haddi hain: yeh software ke peeche ki mantaq dete hain, jis se hum pecheeda masail hal, kaarkardagi behtar aur durustagi yaqeeni banate hain. Google ka search engine PageRank naam ka algorithm istemal karta hai jo kisi page ke links ki tadaad aur maeyar dekh kar search nataij ki darja-bandi karta hai (Did You Know). Algorithms seekhte waqt unhein rozmarra ke maloom kaamon se jorein (Tip).

blocks.prompt: Recipe algorithm ka acha namoona kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh saaf qadmon ki mehdood, tarteeb wali list hai jo diye gaye inputs (ajza) ko nateeje (khane) mein badalti hai.

items: Algorithm: recipe jaisa qadam ba qadam tareeqa; PageRank links se web pages ki darja-bandi karta hai.
